nodes.name: eval_retrieval.py
nodes.summary: DOC_ONLY retrieval evaluation: runs retrieval pipeline on test questions, computes Hit@K (1,3,5,10), MRR, NDCG, fallback rate, and latency. Gold matcher with keyword fallback. Outputs retrieval_eval.json. Supports --reuse flag for cached corpus.

nodes.name: analyze_threshold.py
nodes.summary: Threshold analysis script: analyzes score distributions for positive/negative retrieval results to find optimal RELEVANCE_THRESHOLD. Plots histograms, computes ROC curves, and recommends threshold balancing false positives vs false negatives.

nodes.name: cleanup_eval.py
nodes.summary: Evaluation cleanup script: removes test data from database (conversations, messages, embeddings) created during evaluation runs. Supports --cleanup flag for seed scripts. Ensures clean state between test runs.

nodes.name: diag_retrieve.py
nodes.summary: Retrieval diagnostic script: deep-dive into retrieval failures. Logs vector scores, BM25 scores, rerank scores, and gold rank per query. Identifies failure patterns (OCR issues, chunking, keyword mismatch). Outputs diagnostic JSON.

nodes.name: ocr_tesseract_compare.py
nodes.summary: OCR comparison script: benchmarks Tesseract settings (psm, oem, dpi, lang) on scanned PDFs. Measures character accuracy, diacritic preservation, and processing time. Used to tune pdf_parser.py OCR settings.
